capabilities.name: Customer reply drafting
capabilities.summary: Every customer gets the reply your best person would write. Hand over the customer's message, your tone guide and your approved answers, and get back a draft in your voice where every statement and every promise traces to something you approved. A person on your team reads it, edits it and sends it.

capabilities.name: Support ticket triage
capabilities.summary: Your queue manager opens the morning’s tickets already sorted: each one with a category, a priority and a route, and the reason for all three in a line. The tickets that cannot wait sit at the top, stopped for a person to decide.
